claims.paraphrase: Page title.
By default an editor proves who they are by clicking an emailed link.
An organization on Workspace or Entra maintains a second identity system beside its directory.
A gate in front of /admin replaces the magic link and the roster trusts what the gate says.
The recipe needs a Cloudflare account with Zero Trust and an identity provider.
The Access application fronts all of /admin; there is no partial adoption alongside magic links.
Section heading.
Access sits in front of the Worker and refuses a request before it reaches cairn.
Create a self-hosted Access application scoped to the site hostname covering /admin.
Google Workspace and Entra ID each have their own dedicated connector.
Follow Cloudflare own steps since its console layout changes faster than a copy would stay true.
Every Access application has an AUD tag, distinct from its id, which the verifier validates against.
The AUD tag is found on the application Overview tab.
Section heading.
The roster still decides who may edit by email and the gate only proves an email.
The gate never assigns a role; a proven email with no roster row is refused.
Every roster email must match the primary address the IdP asserts, or that editor is locked out.
Section heading.
The gate-proven email alone joins the gate to the roster.
An Access application guarantee is only as strong as its weakest enabled login method.
Enable only a method that proves control of the asserted address.
Cloudflare one-time PIN is available as a fallback login method.
Never enable a social provider or generic OIDC whose email claim the user can edit.
Cairn has no means to distinguish directory-asserted from self-asserted addresses.
Section heading.
Two admission lists, the Access application and the roster, are never reconciled automatically.
Group membership is unreliable on the token, so the seam does no group-to-role mapping.
Removing someone from the directory blocks the gate; removing from the roster blocks cairn.
Review both lists when someone standing changes.
The free Zero Trust plan is capped by editors authenticating through Access, not by roster size.
Seed the first owner before enabling identity, since identity mode cannot bootstrap one.
No Cloudflare cache rule may match /admin.
The application covers /admin, every path beneath it, and the SvelteKit data-only fetch.
The application must not cover the /preview token route.
Access resolves overlapping rules most specific first, so check the resolved rule after any change.
Leave the application CORS settings off so the CSRF header cannot be set cross-origin.
A hostname reaching the Worker without the gate admits anyone holding a valid token.
Set workers_dev false and preview_urls false, and cover every custom hostname with the application.
An Access application can instead gate the workers.dev and preview hostnames directly.
No tool checks the workers.dev and preview exposure until a later 1.x release.
Check by hand with an unauthenticated GET of the workers.dev and preview hostnames.
A site rate limit is worth having because an ungated /admin spends an RSA verification per request.
Never branch inside resolve for local development; swap the whole guard behind a build-time conditional.
The showcase hooks file swaps its dev backend in behind a build-time conditional.
Cairn ships no OIDC client and does not depend on jose, so nothing typechecks the recipe.
The recipe imports the IdentityResolver types from the sveltekit subpath.
Recipe constants for the team domain and AUD tag with two import-time guards.
Recipe JWKS setup with explicit timing options.
The resolver reads the assertion header, never the CF_Authorization cookie.
The resolver object has logoutUrl, label, and resolve, and refuses a missing assertion.
Recipe jwtVerify call with issuer, audience, and RS256.
The token type claim is observed on real tokens but not documented.
The recipe checks the type is app, not the org session token.
A service-token request has no email and the recipe refuses it.
The resolver returns ok true with the token email.
A certs outage logs as an operator fault rather than a wave of forged tokens.
Recipe mapping of jose error codes onto refusal reasons.
identity.resolve runs on every guarded admin request, never on the public login and auth paths.
The assertion is the only proof, so there is no session to cache it against.
audience, issuer, keys, and error are operator faults; guard.refused carries the split as its level.
The verifier is handed to createAuthGuard identity option and composes with sequence.
Snippet wiring the verifier into hooks.server.ts.
The gate says who; the resolver returns no role and the guard requests none.
A proven identity with no roster row is refused and adding the row works on the next request.
Section heading.
Under identity cairn logout clears its cookies and redirects to logoutUrl.
A stale tab after the gate session ended shows the identity-unresolved page.
Access logout clears the cookie at once and stops accepting tokens in 20 to 30 seconds.
An administrator revocation locks the user out for up to a minute.
The recipe never checks Access revocation, so an issued token stays valid until its exp.
Under identity, the Access session duration acts as the actual admin session lifetime.
Set the session to hours and prefer the roster delete to remove someone right now.
A roster delete takes effect on the very next request whatever the gate session.
The identity types sit in the Unstable API tier, recorded on the reference page.
The first production consumer promotes the seam to the frozen tier.
Nothing about the seam is Cloudflare-specific.
identity takes any IdentityResolver with a resolve and a logoutUrl, so another proxy can implement it.
A reader replacing sign-in probably evaluates the entire authentication surface.
Section heading.
Magic-link mode sends through Cloudflare Email Sending unless auth.send supplies a sender.
The custom sender receives the same message the built-in sender receives.
Section heading.
A BackendProvider commits every concept; the adapter backend carries its kind and default branch.
createGithubApp is the one provider cairn ships; another store implements BackendProvider itself.
